title: Half-term hifdh check: 'Abasa against the rubric: rule card and examples
subject: Qur'an & Tajweed
source: Written for quran/y7 lesson 20 (Pupil PDF worksheet: Half-term hifdh check rule card and examples)
intro: Lesson 20. Read the rule and say every example aloud. Point to each word in your mushaf. Then answer the questions.

panels.title: The check
points: Recite the section the teacher names
Answer one makhraj or raa question

head: Not this
This
rows: Swapping فَأَنتَ لَهُۥ تَصَدَّىٰ (80:6) and فَأَنتَ عَنْهُ تَلَهَّىٰ (80:10)
Rich man: تَصَدَّىٰ (attention, 80:6); sincere seeker: تَلَهَّىٰ (distracted, 80:10)

panels.title: Break plan
points: 'Abasa every day; 7 surahs of the juz' a day

keywords.def: revision of what is already memorised
the checklist used to assess recitation

questions.q: Self-check: recite 80:33 to 42 to yourself and score each rubric row.
Hifdh check: recite to the teacher one by one. While waiting, revise your manzil in breakout pairs and write your break plan.
questions.a: Teacher records rubric scores and one target per pupil in the portal.

questions.q: Extend: write your break plan on the pupil PDF.
questions.a: Daily plan by surah, 10 to 15 minutes, logged.

questions.q: Stretch: begin listening to An-Nazi'at 79:1 to 8 with the mushaf (no new hifdh until checked).
questions.a: Pupil reads along and marks two rules.
A) أُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ هُمُ ٱلْكَفَرَةُ ٱلْفَجَرَةُ. 80:42 is the last ayah.

questions.q: Think again: Juz' 'Amma is almost complete. How will you keep 37 surahs in your heart through the Ramadan break?
questions.a: A daily rota: a slice of the juz' each day, logged; listening to a reciter is extra, not a replacement.
